mask_semantics.mask: true only for TRUE or FALSE; UNKNOWN always has mask=false

physical_criticality.TRUE: known stable grasp or transport/manipulation physical evidence
physical_criticality.FALSE: known physical evidence shows neither critical condition
physical_criticality.UNKNOWN: physical evidence is absent, ambiguous, nonfinite, or right-censored

k10_feasible.TRUE: known remaining horizon is at least 10 and safe_release is FALSE
k10_feasible.FALSE: known remaining horizon is below 10 or safe_release is TRUE
k10_feasible.UNKNOWN: horizon/release evidence is unknown or right-censored

safe_release.TRUE: placement AND release AND stability are all TRUE
safe_release.FALSE: all three components are known and at least one is FALSE

instability.TRUE: known slip, regrasp, or contact-loss evidence is TRUE
instability.FALSE: all instability components are known FALSE
instability.UNKNOWN: any required physical instability component is UNKNOWN

gripper_closing_state.TRUE: finite physical gripper qpos is at or below the frozen threshold
gripper_closing_state.FALSE: finite physical gripper qpos is above the frozen threshold
gripper_closing_state.UNKNOWN: physical qpos or threshold is missing/nonfinite
